rows.notes: GOP Runoff: Julia Letlow (45%) vs. John Fleming (28%) on June 27, 2026. Incumbent Bill Cassidy (R) eliminated with 25% — first incumbent senator to lose a primary since 2012. Cassidy had voted to convict Trump at his 2021 impeachment trial. Democratic runoff: Jamie Davis (47%) vs. Nick Albares (26%) also on June 27. Winner of GOP runoff heavily favored in the November 3 general election.
rows.candidate1_bio: Julia Letlow is a Republican congresswoman representing Louisiana's 5th congressional district since 2021. She holds a Ph.D. in Communication from the University of Louisiana at Lafayette and was elected to fill the seat of her late husband Luke Letlow. She serves on the House Appropriations Committee and is a strong advocate for rural healthcare and agriculture.
rows.candidate2_bio: John Fleming is a Republican politician and former congressman who represented Louisiana's 4th district from 2009 to 2017. A physician and businessman, he later served as Assistant Secretary of the Army for Acquisition, Logistics and Technology under President Trump. He is a staunch conservative and Trump ally who has focused his Senate campaign on opposing carbon storage projects and cutting federal spending.
